greeting: Well hello there, fellow WordPress whisperers!
introParagraph: This week's Release Radar might seem a bit 'fix-it-focused' at first glance, but don't let that fool you. While major feature splashes were few, we saw some crucial under-the-hood refinements and clever additions that make our favorite plugins even more robust and user-friendly. It's all about smoothing out those wrinkles and ensuring a seamless experience for you and your clients.

highlights.title: WPForms Lite 2.0.1.1
highlights.summary: This release might be labeled a 'fix,' but it sneaks in some handy new features: a QR Code generator for your forms and an 'Add Media' button in the confirmation message editor. Now you can easily direct users or spice up your post-submission experience without breaking a sweat.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Instagram Feed 6.13.0
highlights.summary: Ever had your Instagram feed silently showing outdated posts? Smash Balloon's latest update introduces a much-needed warning system, alerting you when your feed is serving stale content due to connection issues. No more embarrassing 'blast from the past' moments for your visitors!

highlights.title: Uncanny Automator 7.6.1.1 & 7.6.1
highlights.summary: Uncanny Automator continues its quest for ultimate automation, with two releases bringing key improvements. From restoring 'Any' options in LearnDash triggers to enhancing Fluent Forms choice field tokens and fixing critical integration issues with Memberium and SureCart, your automated workflows just got a whole lot more reliable and flexible.

highlights.title: MonsterInsights 11.2.0
highlights.summary: For those of us who appreciate clean data, MonsterInsights delivered a solid fix ensuring sample data no longer mingles with your real numbers in reports. This means clearer insights and no more accidental clicks on 'sample' links leading nowhere. Pure, unadulterated analytics goodness!
